details.title: Home Assistant Screensaver for Lyrion Music Server

plugin.name: HAScreenSaver
plugin.title: Home Assistant Screensaver
plugin.desc: Stateless live proxy serving Home Assistant sensor states, weather condition, door/alert status, and radio alarm status to the Home Assistant Clock screensaver applet on Squeezebox Radio / UE Smart Radio, with zero long-term caching. Automatically serves the radio applet over plain local HTTP to Applet Installer.
plugin.creator: Nornode
